evidence: Modifies connection management in `src/net.cpp` and `src/net.h` to deduplicate `-addnode` startup options and recognize default-port equivalences.
rationale: Prevents redundant connection attempts and DNS queries caused by duplicate `-addnode` entries. While disconnected, `ThreadOpenAddedConnections()` repeatedly retried each duplicate entry on every cycle, causing redundant DNS lookups and log noise (author description).
